text.tspan: EBS volume types: SSD for IOPS, HDD for throughput
• one volume attached to up to 16 instances
in the SAME AZ, each with read + write
• encrypts: data at rest, data moving between
the instance and the volume, all snapshots,
all volumes made from those snapshots
• can be on by default per region (account setting)
